name: hu-eli-mcp
description: Hungarian legislation with verifiable citations, from the National Legislation Database (Nemzeti Jogszabalytar, njt.jog.gov.hu): fetch an act or other legal instrument and its text by its native ELI, with lists of document types and issuers. Every answer carries the official source, so a citation can be checked instead of trusted. Queries go only to njt.jog.gov.hu; nothing goes to MateMatic.
